purpose: Bounded real-data responsiveness probe after the trainability proof. This is infrastructure evidence only and is not a deployable or promoted checkpoint.
hypothesis: A conservative Stage-A LoRA update on the clean mixed dataset will begin to move Falcon behavior while preserving capability.

execution.precision: plain FP16 LoRA; no QLoRA on P100

data.public_data_policy: MCQA built from train splits only; no final holdout was read
data.frozen_gate: DEFERRED; no selected system prompt and the final holdout was intentionally excluded

training_result.checkpoint_selection: step 8 selected by lowest fast-dev eval loss, 3.0108089447 vs 3.0118532181 at step 4
training_result.checkpoint_persistence: PASS; step-8 resumable state uploaded to Kaggle Dataset toheebogunade/jamii-afya-falcon-production-checkpoints

generation_behavior.qualitative_observation: Stock and adapter outputs were byte-identical, including the known fabricated-protocol and poor-Kiswahili behaviors in validation.

diagnosis.primary: The probe was underpowered for a behavioral test: 8 optimizer steps at 5e-6 with r=8 and dropout=0.1 produced a tiny held-out loss change and no generation or MCQA movement.
diagnosis.trainability_evidence: The independent 64-step tiny overfit proof passed: loss fell materially, adapter tensors changed, logits changed, reload/off/merge checks passed, and 16/16 generations changed.
diagnosis.next_action: FOLLOW-UP: one bounded canonical Stage-A real-data probe at 16 steps, 3e-5, r=16, alpha=32, dropout=0.05, same clean data and dev/validation-only evaluation. Do not run the frozen gate or promote it.
known_limits: No adapter-on versus stock logit diagnostic was collected in this pilot.
The 5-row MCQA dev slice is directional only.
No quality claim is made from the loss-ranked step-8 adapter.
